item.title: Wakulla High School taps War Eagle alumnus to be next head football coach
item.description: Wakulla High School has tapped alumnus Derek Allen Jr. to be their new head football coach. A community meet-and-greet is planned for next week.

item.title: Wakulla County seniors prepare to lift their way through the Capital City Senior Games next week
item.description: Zoe Ann Mansfield, 84, and J. C. Beaty, 81, are competing in powerlifting events in this year's Capital City Senior Games. They will show their strength by performing dead lifts and bench presses.

item.title: Community leaders in Tallahassee honor the legacy of Rev. Jesse L. Jackson
item.description: Community and civic leaders in Tallahassee gathered Thursday to honor the life and legacy of Rev. Jesse L. Jackson, reflecting on his decades of commitment to civil rights and economic opportunity.
